theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))), IsOpen D → μ Dᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μ K ≠ ∞) → (∀ U : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsOpen U → IsCompact (closure U) → closure U ⊆ D → ∃ Γ : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsClosed Γ ∧ CountablyRectifiable m Γ ∧ μ (U \ Γ) ≤ μ U / 2) → ∃ R : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), MeasurableSet R ∧ CountablyRectifiable m R ∧ μ Rᶜ = 0
